title: Leveraging large language models for participatory digital personas in future-oriented design: a case study of autonomous vehicle intelligent cockpits
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This study introduces a framework using LLMs to create digital personas for future-oriented design, addressing temporal knowledge gaps through human-AI collaboration. It evaluates effectiveness with 18 participants, generating 273 attributes, 120 guidelines, and 72 visual concepts.
exclusion_facts: The study does not collect pure automatic indicators, objective performance, logs, simulations, author discussions, citations, or future research plans.
